subject.title: fix(compaction): emit after_compaction on no-op and use JSON-safe validator delimiters (#81925)

question: Should successful no-op compactions permanently expose `reason?: string` in the public plugin `after_compaction` payload, or should this PR keep the lifecycle repair limited to existing fields plus `compactedCount: 0`?
rationale: The lifecycle bug has a bounded repair, but choosing a new plugin-visible payload semantic is an API/product contract decision that tests alone cannot settle.

options.title: Approve documented additive reason metadata
options.body: Keep `reason`, define its stable values and absence behavior in the plugin hook contract, and land the paired-hook repair.

options.title: Land the narrower lifecycle repair
options.body: Emit `after_compaction` for successful no-ops with `compactedCount: 0` but remove `reason` until a separately approved hook API proposal exists.

options.title: Pause for hook API design
options.body: Defer the PR until the owner decides the broader compaction hook payload model and compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Approve documented additive reason metadata
recommendation.body: Keep `reason`, define its stable values and absence behavior in the plugin hook contract, and land the paired-hook repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related work focused on `after_compaction` payload exposure and plugin-facing hook boundaries, the exact decision surface here.
